description: This file defines functions for listing and managing skill commands within a workspace or for specific agents, including deduplication logic and external dependencies.

methods.name: listSkillCommandsForWorkspace
methods.description: Generates a list of skill command specifications for a given workspace based on provided parameters.

methods.name: dedupeBySkillName
methods.description: Removes duplicate skill commands based on skill name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: listSkillCommandsForAgents
methods.description: Aggregates and lists skill commands for specified agents, merging skill filters and avoiding duplicates.
